rubrics.justification: Generally identifies a Day 5 blastocyst with developed cavity and thinned zona, but is inconsistent on stage (full-to-early expanded vs reported expanded), questions the AA grade, and mentions features like collapse/granularity that may be overinterpreted from a single image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, unexplained infertility, semen quality, endometrial thickness, prior biochemical pregnancy, BMI, and lifestyle factors into prognosis reasonably well, though some interactions are discussed broadly rather than deeply.

Overall logic is understandable, but there are internal inconsistencies around embryo grading and probability ranges, and some conflation between implantation, clinical pregnancy, and live birth before partially clarifying.

Recommendations are mostly consistent with IVF practice, including reliance on embryologist grading, elective single embryo transfer at age 32, and cautious use of further workup only after repeated failures; minor deviations include somewhat loose handling of Gardner terminology and speculative comments.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle modification, and future evaluation after recurrent failure, though the future-cycle section is truncated and some recommendations remain somewhat generic.
